verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into easily parseable text, and its API claims extraction from complicated websites, so the product does provide clean text from pages. The evidence does not say how it handles anti-bot blocking or JavaScript rendering, and it does not specify an LLM-ready format such as markdown. Missing for 10: documented handling of blocking/anti-bot, JS rendering support, explicit LLM-ready output format details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get clean LLM-ready text directly instead of dealing with blocking, rendering, and messy HTML myself

citations.quote: A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.
scrape webpages, quickly search the web, and extract data from complicated websites programmatically
